limitations: Implementation checks do not establish scientific performance, novelty or conference acceptance. Fresh-test outcomes were not read.

Source-max split-conformal calibration is marginal within the declared exchangeable photographic collection and fixed query/view family; it is not a guarantee for every realized split or arbitrary shift.

Hashes cannot establish source independence, semantic deduplication, exchangeability or pretrained-model exposure. Legacy development blocks do not independently certify their original full ResNet checkpoint SHA.

Percentile source-bootstrap gain and nonzero-harm noninferiority intervals are approximate and conditional on fixed fitted models/thresholds; secondary multi-model/family/condition comparisons are descriptive.

The pooled zero-harm bound requires zero any-view harmful source events and source independence at fixed quotas. With 200 sources per family, zero events do not certify a simultaneous 1% family harm margin.
GenImage versus COCO/Open Images is not caption paired. Common encoding/resolution processing does not eliminate semantic or collection confounding.
Registered-message recovery and photographic calibration do not authenticate an issuer or certify unmarked-AI/wrong-payload null rates.
Core cuts on extra conditions are outside their calibration family. Secondary cuts cover only the declared attack family and fixed independent photographic subset.

Diffusion-reconstructed photographs contain generated pixels and retain input-provenance labels. Equal PSNR is not semantic/perceptual equivalence; budget adaptations differ from native published attacks.
Descriptive abstention/risk-coverage has no selective-risk or shift-detection guarantee.
